Subject: Internal: Alicia Gomez — panel sequencing + compacting for 9/14

Team — Alicia confirmed the window but prefers a 9:45am PT start and has a 11:20–11:35 conflict. Two asks before I send the invite:

1) Can Marissa compress the System Design block to 50m with the most critical whiteboard exercise first, then move any follow-ups to the culture slot if needed? That would create a 10m buffer around 11:10–11:20 for her to step out cleanly.
2) Can Laura run the product/cross-functional topic first after the hiring manager instead of second? That helps us keep the deepest technical piece later when Alicia is warmed up.

If we accept the compacted option, I'll add a 15m shadow/backfill slot at end of the loop (12:30–12:45 PT) to catch any overruns or reboards.

Proposed updated schedule (PT):
- 9:45–10:15 — Hiring manager (Karthik) — 30m
- 10:20–11:00 — Product / cross-functional (Laura) — 40m
- 11:10–12:00 — System design (Marissa) — 50m (break window 11:20–11:35)
- 12:05–12:35 — Culture / comp fit (Neha) — 30m
- 12:40–12:55 — Shadow / backfill — 15m

Marissa, Laura, Neha — quick yay/nay? I'll send the invite to Alicia and Zoom scheduler once we agree.

— Karthik
